definitions.full: H7739. shvah II. [ שְׁוָה ] verb Hithpa. be set, made (Pa`el שַׁוִּי make , Cappadocian Aramaic Lzb Eph. i. 67 ; compare Biblical Hebrew II. [ שָׁוָה ]); — Imperfect 3masculine singular יִשְׁתַּוֵּה֑ Dan 3:29 , subject of thing + accusative be made into something (K § 84, 3 ).
